summary:
Main
Iron ore futures and most port spot prices rose modestly today, while seaborne brands and domesticore softened slightly. DCE most-traded closed at 652.5 yuan/mt, up 0.69% from the previous close. Six Qingdao spot products including PB Fines, Newman Fines and Mac Fines rose 3 yuan/wmt, PB Lump gained 1 yuan and Carajas Fines dipped 2 yuan; port 61%, 58% and 65% indices advanced to 640, 597 and 802 yuan/wmt.
